item.title: College Football Playoff expands to 24 teams in 2027
item.description: The CFP unanimously approved a 24-team field beginning in 2027-28, with first-round byes for the top eight seeds and 16 games played on campuses. ESPN will retain worldwide rights through 2031-32. The current 12-team format remains in place this season.

item.title: Cooper Flagg joins elite teenage company with 43-point night
item.description: Cooper Flagg scored 43 points with 10 rebounds and six assists as Dallas rallied past Indiana 125-122. The 19-year-old became only the second teenager in NBA history to produce at least 40 points, 10 rebounds and five assists in a game.

item.title: McDavid extends point streak as historic assist run ends
item.description: Connor McDavid scored in Edmonton's 3-1 win over the Rangers, extending his season-opening point streak to 19 games. His assist streak ended at 18 games, tied with Adam Oates for the second-longest in NHL history behind Wayne Gretzky's 23-game run.

item.title: Bengals win in Madrid to pull even atop AFC North
item.description: Joe Burrow threw three touchdown passes and ran for another as Cincinnati beat Atlanta 34-17 in the NFL's second Madrid game. Ja'Marr Chase had 10 catches for 155 yards, and the Bengals' fourth straight victory moved them to 6-2 and into a tie with Pittsburgh atop the AFC North.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz captures his first Paris Masters title
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz beat Ben Shelton 7-6(5), 7-5 to win the Paris Masters on his sixth attempt. The world No. 3 avenged his U.S. Open loss to Shelton, became the first Spanish champion in Paris since David Ferrer in 2012 and collected his ninth ATP 1000 title.

item.title: Mercedes clinches Formula One constructors' title in wet Brazil
item.description: Mercedes secured its ninth Formula One constructors' championship at a rain-soaked São Paulo Grand Prix, completing a title double one week after Kimi Antonelli won the drivers' crown. Lando Norris won the race for McLaren, while Max Verstappen charged from 21st on the grid to finish second.

item.title: Notre Dame knocks off No. 1 Miami in playoff-shaping win
item.description: CJ Carr threw for 319 yards and three touchdowns as No. 4 Notre Dame built a 21-point lead and held off No. 1 Miami 31-24. The Irish improved to 8-1 and avenged last season's costly loss to the Hurricanes, strengthening their College Football Playoff position.

item.title: Sidney Crosby climbs to sixth on NHL career scoring list
item.description: Sidney Crosby scored twice in Pittsburgh's 5-2 win over Los Angeles, passing Marcel Dionne for sole possession of sixth on the NHL career scoring list. The 39-year-old reached 1,772 points as the Penguins snapped a four-game losing streak.

item.title: Willy Hutchinson wins WBC light-heavyweight title
item.description: Willy Hutchinson beat Joshua Buatsi by unanimous decision in Manchester to claim the vacant WBC light-heavyweight championship. The judges scored the all-British rematch 117-112, 115-113 and 115-113, reversing Hutchinson's defeat to Buatsi in 2024.

item.title: Appeals court hands NCAA key eligibility victory
item.description: The 10th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals reversed a ruling that had granted extra eligibility to athletes who were high school seniors in 2022, a significant win for the NCAA in its wider court fight. The decision does not settle roughly 200 similar state cases involving about 850 athletes.

item.title: Kaden Honeycutt wins NASCAR Truck title at Homestead
item.description: Kaden Honeycutt won the season finale at Homestead-Miami Speedway and captured his first NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series championship. A late tire call helped him take control after Lap 120, and he finished 1.038 seconds ahead for his fifth victory of the season.

item.title: NFL says Brandon Aiyuk owes 49ers about $13 million
item.description: The NFL told Brandon Aiyuk and the players union that the receiver owes San Francisco about $13 million in bonuses, an AP source said. Aiyuk signed a four-year, $120 million extension in 2024 and is seeking reinstatement, deepening his contract dispute with the 49ers.

item.title: LIV Golf to wind down after financing deal collapses
item.description: LIV Golf will liquidate in an orderly wind-down after Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund ended its backing and a proposed $300 million financing agreement with BC Partners collapsed. The breakaway circuit spent more than $5 billion after launching in 2022 and will consider offers for its remaining assets.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo ends record-setting Portugal career
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo retired from international soccer at 41 after 23 years with Portugal. His 234 appearances and 146 goals are men's world records, and he scored at six World Cups. Ronaldo captained Portugal to the 2016 European Championship and Nations League titles in 2019 and 2025.

item.title: Jaguars rout depleted Ravens 33-10
item.description: Trevor Lawrence threw for 242 yards and a touchdown as Jacksonville won for the fifth time in six games. Baltimore, starting rookie Joe Fagnano with Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley injured, lost its fourth straight and became the first Ravens team to drop three consecutive games by at least 20 points.
